name: external soul

attributes.attribute: can hide outside the body in a stone or tree
crushed the soul of Cano Mac Gartnáin
killed Cú Roí by catching the salmon that hid his soul
spread the escaped soul after death

sources: Henderson, George. Survivals in Belief Among the Celts. Glasgow: James MacLeose and Sons, 1911, 76+.
Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: An external soul exists outside the body. It may rest in a stone or a tree. Queen Créd crushed the soul carried by Cano Mac Gartnáin. The warrior Cúchulainn slew his opponent Cú Roí. First he caught the salmon that kept the man's soul. When the salmon died, Cú Roí lost his strength and died. Folklore says moths, butterflies, and bees hold the soul after death. These beings fly out when a person dies.
